whatsappBusinessAccountId.comment: WABA ID captured from the Embedded Signup session_info payload. Set when the OAuthAccount is created via the WhatsApp Coexistence (or Cloud API) Embedded Signup flow.

whatsappPhoneNumberId.comment: Phone number ID captured from the Embedded Signup session_info payload.

whatsappOnboardingType.comment: Type of WhatsApp onboarding completed in the Embedded Signup popup. `coexistence` means the customer also linked the WhatsApp Business app.

whatsappCoexistenceSyncedAt.comment: Set when POST /{phone_number_id}/smb_app_data with smb_app_state_sync completed successfully. Used to skip the (one-time, 24h-deadline) sync on re-activation.

whatsappSessionInfo.comment: Raw session_info payload (sessionInfoVersion 3) from the WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP postMessage event. Kept for diagnostics.
